findings.summary: The refund amount is never checked against the remaining refundable balance (captured amount minus RefundedAmount), so a 60 refund on a 50 payment, or repeated or concurrent refunds of the same payment, pay out more than was captured; the gateway is also called before the save, so a failed SaveAsync leaves money refunded but unrecorded.

sortColumn is interpolated directly into the ORDER BY clause, so a caller-supplied value such as "id; DROP TABLE users--" or a subquery is executed as SQL; it must be mapped through a whitelist of known column names.

reportName is combined into the path without containment, so "..\\..\\appsettings.json" or an absolute path (Path.Combine discards exportRoot for a rooted second argument) reads any file the process can access.
Get returns the document content to any authenticated user without the OwnerId check that Delete performs, so any logged-in user who knows or guesses an id can read another user's document.

The start offset for a 1-based page is computed as pageNumber * pageSize instead of (pageNumber - 1) * pageSize, so page 1 skips the first pageSize items (page 1 of 10 items at size 10 is empty) and every page is shifted by one.
The live webhook signing secret is hard-coded in source, so anyone with access to the repository or binary can forge authentic webhooks and the key cannot be rotated without a redeploy.

The signature is compared with ordinary string equality, which is not constant-time and allows a timing attack to recover a valid signature byte by byte (use CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals on the bytes); a missing signature header (null) also throws NullReferenceException instead of returning false.

The singleton shares a plain Dictionary across concurrent requests and reads, writes and removes it without synchronisation (lines 11, 17, 21), so parallel GetAsync/Invalidate calls can corrupt the dictionary or throw; an Invalidate that lands during an in-flight load is also overwritten with the stale price.
Every exception from sending is caught and discarded with no logging, so if the mail server is down the job silently reports 0 sent and nobody learns that reminders failed or for which invoices.

The method blocks on async calls with .Result and .GetAwaiter().GetResult() (also line 14), which can deadlock under a synchronisation context and starves the thread pool for long batches, with no cancellation; it should be async and awaited.

The length limit is checked only after a hyphen and a character are appended together, so a slug at 79 characters with a pending hyphen grows to 81 (e.g. 79 letters, a space, then one more letter), exceeding MaxLength of 80 and overflowing any column sized to it.
